messages:
alex.p: Quick check — EU edge preflight for tomorrow's canary. Are we green on routing + residency blockers?
mei: infra: routing rules mostly in, PR #4512 open for proxy/nginx config. Waiting on NET-223 peering account so we can finalize egress ACLs.
sam: privacy: legal signoff is conditional on customer-managed KMS for keys. Need KMS ARN from infra to confirm.
alex.p: Mei — can you paste the KMS ARN here when PR is merged? Also who owns the canary rollback playbook?
mei: will paste once merged. PR diff includes the KMS reference. snippet: ```json
{"kms": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-3:123456:key/abcd-ef12-3456"}
```
jamie: oncall: I'll take the canary pager for the window. Please post the runbook and a smoke test command.
alex.p: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-edge-cutover 
alex.p: smoke test (run after proxy canary): ```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}s' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://eu-edge.api.redwood.ai/v1/healthz
```
jamie: noted — will execute at +10m after canary start and post results.
lina: platform: autoscale policy set to target 60% GPU util, burst up to 2x for short spikes. Keep an eye on token latency > 200ms.
mei: added egress rule to allow SIEM ingestion inside EU region, logs will not cross to US. Updated infra PR with that change.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: eu-edge-proxy-v2 -> canary start requested at 3461123600 :rocket:
alex.p: tagging owners — @mei @jamie @sam. If no blockers, proceed with canary. :thumbsup:
sam: privacy quick double-check — are any debug logs shipped to third-party services in US?
mei: no, debug logs are stored in EU SIEM only; external integrations are disabled for canary.
jamie: canary smoke result: 200 0.12s, no errors seen. No residency flags.
alex.p: excellent — thanks. I'll file follow-up for post-canary metrics review and open a short retro ticket.
